title: Revoke third-party OAuth grants
rationale: A grant can be revoked without breaking a business service when the app has a single user.

title: Terminate user sessions
rationale: Sessions of a user flagged by HALT may be terminated; the user signs in again.

title: Conditional-access change for finance users
rationale: Any change that prompts finance users needs the Finance Ops owner or a named delegate.

title: Finance close change freeze, 09:00–11:00Z
rationale: No access-policy change for finance users during close without an exception from the Finance Ops owner.

title: Preserve evidence before containment
rationale: Events, graph snapshot and solver certificate are sealed before any action runs.

title: Irreversible actions (account deletion, mailbox purge)
rationale: Never proposed by HALT unless nothing reversible works. Not in this catalogue.

title: Isolate an API
rationale: Isolating a shared API interrupts every dependent process.

title: Isolate a database
rationale: Database isolation is a business-wide outage.

title: Network-isolate a subnet
rationale: Subnet isolation is a business-wide outage.

title: Disable a user account
rationale: A disabled user cannot perform any business role until re-enabled.

title: Force a password reset
rationale: Password resets do not revoke issued tokens or grants.

title: Edge network block
rationale: Edge blocks are evadable and are never relied on alone.

title: Tenant-wide consent revocation
rationale: Revoking every grant breaks every integration.

title: Quarantine a mailbox
rationale: Stops further mail-borne access; does not affect issued tokens.
